ModMetaData.name: Parametric
ModMetaData.author: aRed
ModMetaData.description:
Parametric is a lightweight background systems mod. Load Support derives each pawn's carrying capability from its actual body. Overload lets pawns carry past their comfortable capacity, at a reactive cost in movement.
Load Support Each pawn gets a Load Support multiplier (healthy = x1.00) worked out from the current state of its legs, core (spine, pelvis, torso) and arms. Missing limbs lower it; prosthetics, bionics, archotech parts and modded replacement parts raise it.
- Works with modded bionics and races without compatibility patches. It reads RimWorld's own part-efficiency system, not DefNames. - Superhuman parts scale nonlinearly (efficiency^2.5 by default). - There is a structural bottleneck: super-legs on a normal spine help, but the spine limits them. - Multiplies the existing carrying capacity, so genes, traits, body size and other mods are kept. Vanilla's Manipulation factor is corrected so arms aren't counted twice. - Optionally also applies to inventory and caravan mass.
Overload Each player pawn gets an Overload gizmo (No overload / 75% / 50% / 25% / 10%) that sets how far past its comfortable mass capacity normal loading may go. - Movement slows continuously with the mass the pawn actually supports (x0.75 at 125% of comfortable, x0.25 at 175%). The chosen percentage is a loading limit, not a speed guarantee. - If injuries lower a pawn's capacity, excess droppable cargo spills, with partial stacks split. Armor and weapons are never stripped; if they alone are too heavy, the pawn is simply very slow. - Non-player pawns use a global policy, so wounded raiders drop loot. Trade caravans are left to vanilla. - Right-click the gizmo to apply a pawn's setting to the whole colony.
Saves: Load Support stores nothing. Overload stores only the individual policies you choose. Safe to add mid-game.
Requires Harmony.
